scripts.new:question: node scripts/new-question-template.mjs
scripts.build: npm run sync:index && npm run validate:questions && tsc && cp index.html styles.css 404.html docs/ && rm -rf docs/question && node scripts/generate-question-data.mjs && cp docs/main.js main.js && cp docs/question-data.js question-data.js
scripts.dev: npm run build && python3 -m http.server 4173 --directory docs
